Package hadur117.sepia

Class Arcs

java.lang.Object
hadur117.sepia.Arcs
public final class Arcs extends Object
Bearing arithmetic for hit sets and shadows. A hit set is the interval [lo, hi] of bearings from a wave's source whose bullet would meet the body (INK-5's "share of the hit set"); a shadow is a list of [low, high] bearing intervals as BulletShadows returns them. Every interval is first moved by whole turns to within pi of the hit set's middle, so the seam at plus or minus pi never splits one. Pure functions; nothing here holds state.

  • Method Details

    • shade

      public static double shade(double lo, double hi, List<double[]> certain, List<double[]> possible)
      The share of [lo, hi] shaded: a bearing in a certain shadow counts 1, one only in a possible shadow a half (INK-5). possible includes the certain bearings, as BulletShadows.of returns it, so the share is (certain + possible) / 2 of the width.
      Parameters:
      lo - the hit set's low bearing, radians
      hi - the hit set's high bearing, radians (hi >= lo)
      certain - the certain shadows
      possible - every bearing that may be stopped, certain ones included
      Returns:
      a share in [0, 1]; 0 for an empty hit set
